transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, since I stopped working, I just can’t seem to slow down. I’m up and moving all day, going from one little job to the next around the house, like I still have a crew waiting on me or something. It’s getting to where I figured I should talk to somebody about it.
Have you been sleeping less than usual since this started?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of it. I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change in my sleep, but I couldn’t say for certain.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual, or that you feel rested even if you haven’t slept much?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I mean, I don’t think I’m getting by on way less sleep and feeling great or anything. I just haven’t paid close enough attention to say for sure.
Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually upbeat, overly confident, or unusually irritable lately?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed feeling especially upbeat or overly confident. Irritable… maybe a little now and then, but nothing that really stands out to me as unusual.
Have you noticed yourself talking more quickly than usual or having thoughts that seem to race from one thing to the next?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. Sometimes my mind jumps around a bit, but I wouldn’t say my thoughts are racing or that I’m talking faster than usual.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure in things or have lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?
Not really, no. I still enjoy the usual things when I get around to them. I haven’t noticed losing interest or feeling like things aren’t pleasurable anymore.
Have you noticed that you feel rested and ready to go even after only a few hours of sleep?
No, I can’t say I’ve noticed that. If I only get a few hours of sleep, I usually don’t feel especially rested or ready to go.
Have you noticed that you need significantly less sleep than usual, like feeling fully energized after only a few hours of sleep?
No, I haven’t noticed that. If I sleep only a few hours, I don’t feel fully energized or anything like that.
Have you noticed that you feel like you don’t need as much sleep as usual, even if your body seems to be going nonstop?
No, I don’t think so. If I’m not sleeping enough, I feel it. I haven’t had that feeling like I can just keep going without needing sleep.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that where it was most of the day, nearly every day for two weeks. At least, nothing that stands out to me that way.
Have you noticed that you feel like you don’t need as much sleep as usual, even if your body seems to be going nonstop?
No, I don’t think I’ve had that. When I don’t sleep much, I usually feel tired, not like my body can just keep going.
Have you noticed that you feel like you don’t need as much sleep as usual, even if you're still active during the day?
No, not really. If I’m short on sleep, I notice it during the day. I don’t get that feeling like I can stay active and not need the rest.
Have you noticed that you need significantly less sleep than usual, like feeling fully energized after only a few hours of sleep?
No, I can’t say I’ve noticed that. If I only get a few hours of sleep, I don’t feel fully energized—I usually feel like I didn’t sleep enough.
Have you noticed that you feel like you can't stop talking, or that your thoughts are moving so fast you can't keep up?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I might talk a bit when I’m engaged in something, but not like I can’t stop, and I don’t feel like my thoughts are racing faster than I can handle.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t think so. I’ve had days where I felt down, sure, but not for two weeks straight most of the day like that.
Have you noticed that you feel like you can’t stop talking once you start, or that your thoughts are jumping from one idea to another so quickly that it’s hard to focus?

Not so much that I can’t stop talking, no. It’s more that my attention jumps. Like if I’m trying to paint or plan out a story and I hear a truck outside, or I suddenly think about something in the garden, my mind goes right over there and then I lose where I was.
Have you noticed that you feel just fine and fully alert during the day even if you didn’t sleep much the night before?
No, I don’t think so. If I don’t sleep much, I usually feel it the next day. I’m not just perfectly alert like nothing happened.
Have you noticed that you feel just as energetic and ready to go even if you haven’t slept much at all the night before?
No, not really. If I don’t get much sleep, I’m usually tired the next day. I don’t feel just as energetic or ready to go.
Have you noticed that you feel worthless or guilty about things more than usual?
Not really, no. I mean, I can feel frustrated with myself sometimes, but I haven’t noticed feeling worthless or especially guilty more than usual.
Have you ever felt that you don't need as much sleep as usual, even if you're still active and busy during the day?
No, I can’t say I’ve noticed that. If I’m busy during the day after not sleeping much, I usually still feel tired at some point. I don’t really get that feeling like I just don’t need sleep.

This could point to mania (F30.1), hypomania (F31.1), unspecified manic episode (F06.3), or possibly anxiety (F43.1) related to the change in routine.
